prompt_extra:
- Plain JSX, no wrapper component. Include <AuthorBox /> with NO props near the end.
- AuthorBox accepts no props at all.
- YMYL FINANCIAL PAGE. Never state a specific current interest rate, APR or a
  'average rate for <month>' as fact. Speak in ranges tied to credit tiers, or tell
  the reader to check a live rate source. Never invent lender names or loan limits.
